programme.title: Prokletstvo zlata iz Građanskog rata
programme.desc: Pošto imaju samo još jednu priliku da ubede Martija da se pridruži njihovoj potrazi, tim odlazi na zapad gde su otkriveni novi tragovi.

programme.title: Ratnici
programme.desc: Teri Šapert otkriva zašto su vikinge nazivali "Srednjevekovnim Anđelima pakla". On ispituje oružja i taktike koje su koristili pri pljačkanju Evrope. Ipak, naišli su na ravnog protivnika, Saksonce, u bici kod Maldona.

programme.title: Život posle ljudi
programme.desc: Bez ljudi, otkrijte sudbinu Las Vegasa i Atlantik Sitija, gde bi okean uništio kazina i pacovi bi preovladali.

programme.title: Kopanje za istinom
programme.desc: Priča o tajanstvenom nestanku Indijanaca iz plemena Anasazi.

programme.title: Drevni vanzemaljci
programme.desc: Vikinzi su se klanjali tajanstvenim i zastrašujućim bogovima. Stručnjaci istražuju da li su možda njihovi bogovi bili posetioci sa druge planete.

programme.title: Pohod na monstrume
programme.desc: Velike mačke koje vrebaju delovima Amerike razvile su apetit za ljudsko meso. Svedoci u državi Njujork kažu da viđaju velike crne mačke. Međutim, samo jaguari i leopardi se uklapaju u opis, a nijedan nema stanište u istočnom delu Amerike.

programme.title: Lovci na NLO
programme.desc: Putujte SAD i van njenih granica da čujete priče iskusnih, odlikovanih policajaca koji su imali neverovatne, ali potkrepljene, susrete sa NLO.

programme.title: Nestali na Aljasci
programme.desc: Tim istražuje najstrožije čuvano državno postrojenje u kom se navodno nalazi elektromagnetni generator kriv za nestanke na Aljasci.

programme.title: Prokletstvo zlata iz Građanskog rata
programme.desc: Pošto imaju samo još jednu priliku da ubede Martija da se pridruži njihovoj potrazi, tim odlazi na zapad gde su otkriveni novi tragovi.

programme.title: Najužasnije vremenske neprilike
programme.desc: Zanimljiva dokumentarna serija koja prikazuje neuništivu silu prirode, sa sve nestabilnijim prirodnim katastrofama i ekstremnim vremenskim uslovima koji pogađaju planetu.

programme.title: Rečna čudovišta
programme.desc: Ekstremni ribolovac Džeremi Vejd je u potrazi za rečnom ribom koja voli ljudsko meso. Koristeći forenzičke metode, Džeremi pokazuje kako su ova rečna čudovišta programirana da ubiju.

programme.title: Bojna polja u divljini
programme.desc: Pokazujemo kako životinje koriste svoje jedinstvene atribute da pobede svoje protivnike; milenijumima su brusili svoje veštine i postali majstori komunikacije, kamuflaže, diplomatije i borbe.

programme.title: Veliki koralni greben Dejvida Atenboroua
programme.desc: Veliki koralni greben je najveća živa struktura na našoj planeti. Ovo je temeljan prikaz te biološke znamenitosti, u kome je voditelj Monti Hols istražuje u čitavoj njenoj dužini od 2 000 kilometara.

programme.title: Odbrojavanje do erupcije
programme.desc: Vulkani se ubrajaju u najmoćnije sile na Zemlji. Od Vezuva do Hunga Tonge, oni mogu da unište klimu i gradove, ali i da oblikuju zemlju, tlo i život.

programme.desc: Veliki koralni greben je najveća živa struktura na našoj planeti. Ovo je temeljan prikaz te biološke znamenitosti, u kome je voditelj Monti Hols istražuje u čitavoj njenoj dužini od 2 000 kilometara.

programme.title: Raselina Sveti Andreja: trka sa vremenom
programme.desc: Kalifornija je jedna od najaktivnijih seizmičkih zona na svetu. Raselina Sveti Andreja je mesto spajanja dve tektonske ploče i proteže se duž San Franciska i Los Anđelesa. Duga je 1 300 kilometara, široka je 140 kilometara i trenutno je fenomen koji izaziva najviše pažnje na svetu. Ali zbog čega je tako i na koji način ona ugrožava lokalno stanovništvo? Naučnici tvrde da bi jačina raseline mogla da dostigne broj 9, što je najveća jačina po Rihterovoj skali. Kako se naučnici pripremaju za najgore i kako da predvide nepredvidivo?

programme.title: Odbrojavanje do erupcije
programme.desc: Pacifička obala Severne Amerike nalazi se na veoma aktivnom delu Zemljine kore, gde sporo pokretne tektonske ploče doprinose stvaranju dugog lanca vulkana od skoro 10 000 km.

programme.title: Odbrojavanje do erupcije
programme.desc: Evropa se nalazi na aktivnim tektonskim zonama, od Islanda do Italije. Drevni vulkani ispod njenih gradova i obala i dalje predstavljaju rizik koji bi mogao da utiče na Evropu i šire.

programme.title: Odbrojavanje do erupcije
programme.desc: Vulkani se ubrajaju u najmoćnije sile na Zemlji. Od Vezuva do Hunga Tonge, oni mogu da unište klimu i gradove, ali i da oblikuju zemlju, tlo i život.

programme.title: Odbrojavanje do erupcije
programme.desc: Jugoistočna Azija ima mnogo aktivnih vulkana. Oni su izazvali velike erupcije, cunamije, oštećenja gradova i klimatske posledice, a milioni ljudi žive u blizini.

programme.title: Život ispod nule
programme.desc: Ova serija nas vodi duboko u aljasku zimu, kako bismo upoznali šest vrsti stanovnika koji pokušavaju da budu korak ispred.

programme.desc: Ova serija nas vodi duboko u aljasku zimu, kako bismo upoznali šest vrsti stanovnika koji pokušavaju da budu korak ispred.

programme.title: Planinski veterinar
programme.desc: Od tvoraca serije "Jorkširski veterinar" dolazi nam emisija "Veterinar iz Hajlenda" _ dokumentarna serija smeštena u najseverniju britansku ordinaciju na kopnu, u Kejtnesu. Snimljena tokom surovih zima i proleća, serija prati veterinare, medicinske sestre i osoblje dok brinu o domaćim životinjama, kućnim ljubimcima, konjima i divljim životinjama. Pratimo živote životinja i upoznajemo jedan posvećen tim. Nijedan dan za njih nije isti.

programme.title: Planinski veterinar
programme.desc: Od tvoraca serije "Jorkširski veterinar" dolazi nam emisija "Veterinar iz Hajlenda" _ dokumentarna serija smeštena u najseverniju britansku ordinaciju na kopnu, u Kejtnesu. Snimljena tokom surovih zima i proleća, serija prati veterinare, medicinske sestre i osoblje dok brinu o domaćim životinjama, kućnim ljubimcima, konjima i divljim životinjama. Pratimo živote životinja i upoznajemo jedan posvećen tim. Nijedan dan za njih nije isti.

programme.title: Atenborouove čudesne pesme
programme.desc: Ser Dejvid Atenborou bira svoje omiljene snimke iz sveta prirode, koji objašnjavaju poj životinja. Svaki od njih, od pesme najvećeg lemura do pesme grbavog kita, snimljen je za njegovog života. "Postoji sedam snimaka pesama, koji su mi posebno zanimljivi", kaže on. "Neki su divni, neki su iznenađujući, a jedan mi je skoro slomio srce. Ali svi su na neki način posebni". Nauka o pesmi je prethodno bila transformisana teorijom seksualne selekcije Čarlsa Darvina _ pevanje je opasno jer otkriva lokaciju pevača predatorima. Pored toga, mužjaku nudi ogromnu nagradu u vidu šanse da privuče ženku i prenese gene na sledeću generaciju. Ali nova naučna otkrića ukazuju na to da treba još mnogo toga da se nauči o pesmi u svetu prirode.

programme.title: Atenborouova čudesna jaja
programme.desc: Ser Dejvid Atenboro gaji strast prema ptičjim jajima. Ove izvanredne strukture neguju novi život, štiteći ga od spoljašnjeg sveta istovremeno mu omogućavajući da diše. Dovoljno su jake da izdrže punu težinu roditelja koji se inkubira i dovoljno slabe da omoguće mladima da se oslobode, ali kako se jaje pravi, zašto je takvog oblika i, možda najvažnije, zašto ptice uopšte nose jaja? Delić po delić, od stvaranja do izleganja, ser Dejvid otkriva čudo koje stoji iza ovih čuda prirode.

programme.title: Ajkula šef
programme.desc: Naučnici slabo razumeju društvenu dinamiku velikih belih ajkula. Obično usamljeni lovci, one se okupljaju u određeno doba godine i najednom postaju društvena bića. Sada su stručnjaci za ajkule, dr Rajli Eliot i Kori Burkhard, domaćini uzbudljivog takmičenja, koje, za razliku od svih prethodnih, ima za cilj da po prvi put otkrije koji mužjak velike bele ajkule vlada kao alfa u jatu. Ovaj jedinstveni obračun testira brzinu, lovačku snagu i neustrašivost ajkula kako bi otkrio vođu čopora koji će dobiti prva prava na parenje sa velikim ženkama kada počne sezona parenja. Ovo je dokumentarac koji zaranja duboko da bi posmatrao do sada nepoznato ponašanje ajkula.

programme.title: Mega ajkule Opasnog grebena
programme.desc: U udaljenim vodama poluostrva Ejr, u Južnoj Australiji, i dalje kruže glasine o ogromnim mega ajkulama od 5,5 metara koje vrebaju u dubinama. Ova kolosalna stvorenja se retko viđaju na popularnim Neptunovim ostrvima, poznatoj destinaciji za ronjenje u kavezima. Dr Loren Mejer, stručnjak za bele ajkule, i Kolin Trap, podvodni snimatelj, kreću u ekspediciju kako bi razotkrili misteriju. Njihova misija je da snime jednog od ovih neuhvatljivih divova i rasvetle njihovo misteriozno ponašanje.

programme.title: Frankenšark
programme.desc: Velika bela ajkula se često naziva savršenim predatorom prirode, ali moćna bela ajkula više nije na vrhu lanca ishrane. Tokom proteklih nekoliko godina, kamerama su snimljeni jezivi napadi, koji imenuju orku za kralja okeana. Šta bi bilo potrebno da se ajkule suprotstave udarcu? Tim stručnjaka za ajkule stavlja ove zveri na probu.

programme.title: Bojna polja u divljini
programme.desc: Pokazujemo kako životinje koriste svoje jedinstvene atribute da pobede svoje protivnike; milenijumima su brusili svoje veštine i postali majstori komunikacije, kamuflaže, diplomatije i borbe.

programme.title: Optužena
programme.desc: Temeljen prema istinitoj priči, o mladoj ženi koja je bila silovana i koja nikako ne uspeva da pronađe pravdu na sudu. Sara Tobias predstavlja nam ljudsku prirodu, moralnu savest i sudski proces koji žrtvu predstavlja kao kriminalca.

programme.title: Kad stranac pozove
programme.desc: Naizgled bezbrižan posao dadilje, za srednjoškolku Džil pretvoriće se u pravu noćnu moru nakon što bude počela da dobija čudne telefonske pozive.

programme.title: Zaleđeno
programme.desc: Kad se Arijelina dugo otuđena majka iznenada vrati u njihov izolovani dom, to poremeti njen naizgled savršen odnos s ocem i otkriva jezivu, mračnu prošlost...

programme.title: Mrtav čovek
programme.desc: Brajant, čovek misteriozne prošlosti, seli se u mali meksički pogranični grad kako bi počeo ispočetka i živeo jednostavan život. Nevoljno se sprijateljuje sa problematičnim lokalnim tinejdžerom koji je nedavno izgubio majku i koga regrutuje lokalna ulična banda. Brajant održava dečaka na pravom putu tako što ga uči borilačkim veštinama i preuzima ulogu mentora, učitelja i očinske figure. Kako se priča odvija, saznajemo da je Brajant mnogo više od čoveka koji se preselio u Meksiko da bi živeo jednostavan život. Brajant beži od složene, nasilne prošlosti za koju veruje da je ostavio iza sebe. Kako ga prošlost sustiže, primoran je da se bori na život ili smrt kako bi očistio svoje ime, spasao dečaka i povratio sve što je ostavio iza sebe...

programme.title: Ljudi uzorci
programme.desc: Životi četiri grupe mladih Australijanaca bivaju isprepletani kada za vikend krenu put Sidneja.

programme.title: Kad stranac pozove
programme.desc: Naizgled bezbrižan posao dadilje, za srednjoškolku Džil pretvoriće se u pravu noćnu moru nakon što bude počela da dobija čudne telefonske pozive.

programme.title: Ućutkivanje
programme.desc: Nikolaj Koster-Valdau glumi Rejburna Svonsona, bivšeg lovca koji, nakon nestanka svoje ćerke, živi povučeno u šumi da bi zaštitio upravo one životinje koje je lovio. Ali kad se učini da je serija nedavnih ubistava povezana s otmicom njegove ćerke, Rejburn koristi svoje lovačke veštine da pronađe ubicu u smrtonosnoj igri mačke i miša.

programme.title: Zavera Ešalon
programme.desc: Misteriozne poruke na mobilnom telefonu obećavaju mladom američkom inženjeru neopisivo bogatstvo, da bi na kraju postao meta smrtonosnog međunarodnog zapleta. Opasni tajni operativci gone inženjera širom sveta, dok moćni zvaničnik vlade pokušava da stane na put misterioznom planu koji bi ugrozio stabilnost čitavog sveta.

programme.title: Fanatik
programme.desc: Priča prati autističnog muškarca Musa koji je opsednut slavnim ličnostima. On ih proganja, dolazi na okupljanja kako bi dobio njihove autograme i zna gde oni žive. Posebno mu je drag glumac iz akcionih filmova, Hanter Danbar, i jedva čeka da se upozna sa njim. Međutim, Danbar nema vremena da se bavi svojim obožavateljem, odbije ga nekoliko puta vrlo grubo, što Musa razbesni i razočara, ali nije prestao da ga proganja. Mus ga kidnapuje, i počinje mučiti svog omiljenog akcionog junaka.

programme.title: Fanatik
programme.desc: Priča prati autističnog muškarca Musa koji je opsednut slavnim ličnostima. On ih proganja, dolazi na okupljanja kako bi dobio njihove autograme i zna gde oni žive. programme.title: Kurir
programme.desc: Markantni Dostavljač odlučan je profesionalac specijalizovan za dostavu svih vrsta pošiljki. On je najpouzdanija osoba za taj posao, jer ih bez pitanja isporučuje i na nemoguća mesta. Dostavljač je usamljenik koji živi u trošnom stanu, u kom mu je jedino društvo miš kojeg tretira poput kućnog ljubimca. Kad mu jednog dana pristupi zagonetni Lispi, Dostavljač pristane kovčeg nepoznatog sadržaja isporučiti Evilu Sevilu. On ne zna da je Lispi agent FBI _ ja koji preko njega želi doći do Sevila, opasnog kriminalca koji je navodno ubijen još pre deset godina. Čini se da je Sevil živ i da priprema osvetu onima koji su ga prevarili, a u tome mu pomaže njegov nekadašnji partner Maksvel. Kad nasluti u šta se upleo, Dostavljač će se morati osloniti na pomoć svoje kćeri Ane i starog prijatelja Stiča. No, sve možda i nije onako kakvim se čini...

programme.title: Brak preko interneta
programme.desc: Šokantno iznenađenje čeka Brajana, koji posle razvoda upozna i oženi naizgled savršenu ženu.

programme.title: Litica
programme.desc: Avantura penjanja između dva prijatelja pretvara se u zastrašujuću noćnu moru. Nakon što Kelly kamerom snimi ubistvo svoje najbolje prijateljice, ona postaje sledeća meta usko povezane grupe prijatelja koji se neće zaustaviti ni pred čim da unište dokaze i svakoga na putu. Očajna za svoju sigurnost, ona počinje izdajničko penjanje uz planinsku liticu i njeni instinkti preživljavanja su stavljeni na iskušenje kada bude zarobljena sa ubicama udaljenim samo 20 stopa.

programme.title: Ubiti Slejda
programme.desc: Slade je (Patrick Dollaghan) američki plaćenik koji je postao rendžer, a J.J. (Lisa Brady) je američka novinarka. Jedan od Sladeovih starih saboraca, Flannigan (Danny Keogh) regrutuje ga da otme J.J. kada stigne u Congellu kako bi je spriečio da otkrije krađu hrane koju dobija od Ujedinjenih nacija. Ali, Slade uskoro saznaje da je prevaren kada otkrije da je njegov stari sunarodnik šef operacije.

programme.desc: Markantni Dostavljač odlučan je profesionalac specijalizovan za dostavu svih vrsta pošiljki. On je najpouzdanija osoba za taj posao, jer ih bez pitanja isporučuje i na nemoguća mesta. Dostavljač je usamljenik koji živi u trošnom stanu, u kom mu je jedino društvo miš kojeg tretira poput kućnog ljubimca. Kad mu jednog dana pristupi zagonetni Lispi, Dostavljač pristane kovčeg nepoznatog sadržaja isporučiti Evilu Sevilu. On ne zna da je Lispi agent FBI _ ja koji preko njega želi doći do Sevila, opasnog kriminalca koji je navodno ubijen još pre deset godina. Čini se da je Sevil živ i da priprema osvetu onima koji su ga prevarili, a u tome mu pomaže njegov nekadašnji partner Maksvel. Kad nasluti u šta se upleo, Dostavljač će se morati osloniti na pomoć svoje kćeri Ane i starog prijatelja Stiča. No, sve možda i nije onako kakvim se čini...

programme.title: Fanatik
programme.desc: Priča prati autističnog muškarca Musa koji je opsednut slavnim ličnostima. On ih proganja, dolazi na okupljanja kako bi dobio njihove autograme i zna gde oni žive. Posebno mu je drag glumac iz akcionih filmova, Hanter Danbar, i jedva čeka da se upozna sa njim. Međutim, Danbar nema vremena da se bavi svojim obožavateljem, odbije ga nekoliko puta vrlo grubo, što Musa razbesni i razočara, ali nije prestao da ga proganja. Mus ga kidnapuje, i počinje mučiti svog omiljenog akcionog junaka.

programme.title: Zavera Ešalon
programme.desc: Misteriozne poruke na mobilnom telefonu obećavaju mladom američkom inženjeru neopisivo bogatstvo, da bi na kraju postao meta smrtonosnog međunarodnog zapleta. Opasni tajni operativci gone inženjera širom sveta, dok moćni zvaničnik vlade pokušava da stane na put misterioznom planu koji bi ugrozio stabilnost čitavog sveta.

programme.title: Šerlok Holms
programme.desc: Najnovija dinamična adaptacija priče Artura Konana Dojla o najpoznatijem detektivu na svetu stavlja Šerloka Holmsa i njegovog mudrog partnera Votsona pred nove izazove. Njegove fizičke veštine jednako su opasne kao i njegova legendarna pamet i on se upušta u bitku uma i snage sa neprijateljima koji predstavljaju pretnju za celu Englesku.

programme.title: Da Vinčijev kod
programme.desc: Boraveći poslom u Parizu, harvardski simbolista Robert Langdon dobija hitan noćni poziv kojim ga obaveštavaju da je kustos muzeja Luvr ubijen. U prostorijama muzeja, pokraj tela, policija pronalazi šifrovanu poruku. Dok pokušava da reši misterioznu zagonetku, Langdon otkriva da ona upućuje na serije ingeniozno sakrivenih tragova u Da Vinčijevim delima. Langdon se udružuje s nadarenim francuskim kriptologom Sofi Nevo i saznaje da je pokojni kustos bio član Sionskog priorata _ tajnog društva čiji su članovi bili Isak Njutn, Botičeli, Viktor Igo i Da Vinči. U uzbudljivoj trci kroz Pariz, London i dalje Langdon i Nevo suočiće se s tajnim moćnikom koji predviđa svaki njihov potez. Ukoliko Langdon i Nevo ne dešifruju zagonetku na vreme, antička tajna i šokantna istina koja može promeniti tok istorije biće zauvek izgubljena.

programme.title: Prljavi Hari
programme.desc: Kada ludak i ubica koji sebe naziva "Škorpion" počne da zlostavlja grad, žestoki policajac iz San Franciska, inspektor "Prljavi" Hari Kalahan dobija zadatak da pronađe i uhapsi pobesnelog psihopatu.

programme.title: Gospodin džoint
programme.desc: Životna priča elitnog britanskog krijumčara droge _ Hauarda Marksa, zvanog Mister Najs. U svojoj bogatoj karijeri bavio se raznim zanimanjima: bio je putnički agent, promoter rok-koncerata, pisac, i najveći krijumčar marihuane na svetu. On je čovek koji je imao četrdeset tri lažna imena, četvoro dece, osamdeset devet telefonskih linija, dvadeset pet firmi, i preko milion prodatih knjiga.

programme.title: Otporan na metke
programme.desc: Lopov izvodi pljačku života kada opljačka psihopatskog narkobosa Templea. Plan se odvija bez problema sve dok lopov ne otkrije neočekivanu putnicu u svom automobilu _ Templeovu trudnu ženu Miju. Razjareni Temple i njegova desna ruka, profesionalni plaćeni ubojica Francuz, jure za lopovom koji je rastrzan između želje da se pritaji i riskantnog plana da pomogne Miji osloboditi se svog okrutnog supruga. U svakom slučaju, njihova jedina šansa da ostanu živi je da stisnu gas do daske.

programme.title: Čistilište
programme.desc: Dr Molenar i njegova koleginica Emili Kolman garantuju emocionalno i psihološko olakšanje, iako svako od njih ima različito tumačenje terapijskih metoda _ Kolman ima klinički, dok se Molenar se više oslanja na upotrebu okultnog. Kriminalistički psiholog Noa Bišop prati troje svojih pacijenata sa odeljenja za kriminal u sanatorijum, verujući da program može nanovo poboljšati život ovih mladih zatvorenika. Molenarov zlokobni plan je otvoreni "obrnuti egzorcizam": pacijente želi da iskoristi kao razmenu za demonska stvorenja, koja čekaju duboko na imanju na kojem je sanatorijum izgrađen. Iako mnogi pacijenti misle da bi sve mogla biti halucinacija, Noa, uz pomoć Emili _ njegove bivše učenice _ mora da ostane pri zdravoj pameti i spreči Molenarov brutalni tim upravnika da pripremi dolazak "zveri".

programme.title: Šerlok Holms: Igra senki
programme.desc: Šerlok Holms je oduvek bio najpametniji čovek u sobi... sve do sada. Na pozornicu je stupio novi kriminalni genije, profesor Moriarti i osim što je intelektualni Holmsov parnjak, njegov kapacitet za zlo, uparen sa potpunim odsustvom savesti, možda će mu dati prednost u odnosu na poznatog detektiva. Kada je krunisani princ Austrije pronađen mrtav, dokazi ukazuju na samoubistvo. Ali, Šerlok Holms zaključuje da je princ bio žrtva ubistva _ ubistva koji je samo jedan deo u većoj i mnogo opasnijoj slagalici koju je osmislio profesor Moriarti. Lukavi Moriarti je uvek jedan korak ispred Holmsa dok raspreda mrežu smrti i uništenja _ sve u sklopu većeg plana koji će, ako uspe, promeniti tok istorije.

programme.title: Slomljena srca
programme.desc: Film prati kantri muzički duo koji traži privatnu vilu svog idola i završavaju u uvrnutom nizu užasa, koji ih prisiljava da se suoče s granicama na kojim bi želeli ostvariti svoje snove...

programme.title: Pljačkaši izgubljenih faraona
programme.desc: U 19. veku, evropske sile tragale su za egipatskim faraonskim blagom. Pioniri egiptologije balansiraju između otkrivanja i pljačke na epskom putovanju, oživljenom kroz dramski prikaz i 3D tehnologiju.

programme.title: Pljačkaši izgubljenih faraona

programme.title: Egipatske grobnice: Imhotep, tvorac piramida
programme.desc: Arheolog Zahi Havas i njegov tim kreću u uzbudljivu potragu za Imhotepovom grobnicom. On je bio najveći učenjak drevnih vremena i arhitekta Stepenaste piramide faraona Džosera.

programme.title: Egipatske grobnice: Imhotep, tvorac piramida
programme.desc: Zahi Havas iskopava pronalazište po imenu Gisr El Mudir, gde su pronaženi sarkofazi sa misterioznim mumijama i bogato oslikanim grobnicama. Hoće li ih ova otkrića odvesti do Imhotepa?

programme.title: Tajna nacistička nauka
programme.desc: Kada se, krajem II sv. Rata, nacističko carstvo urušilo, otkrivene su mračne tajne Trećeg rajha. Ova serija će ih otkriti _ od bioloških eksperimenata do velikih inženjerskih podviga.

programme.title: Tajna nacistička nauka

programme.title: Dolina kraljeva - otkrivanje tajne grobnice
programme.desc: Pratimo prvo aktivno iskopavanje faraonove grobnice, u kultnoj Dolini kraljeva, još od grobnice kralja Tuta, pre jednog veka, i otkrivamo nove tajne o poznatim egipatskim vladarima.

programme.title: Drugi svetski rat: Cena vlasti
programme.desc: Priča o tome kako se svet, koji se stvarao vekovima, potpuno promenio u nekoliko ratnih godina. Tradicionalne moći izgubile su svoj značaj, u naletu novih snaga koje su oblikovale svet.

programme.title: Geografija rata - Drugi svetski rat
programme.desc: Ova emisija pristupa najvećem sukobu moderne istorije, istražujući ključne vojne pohode Drugog svetskog rata, i to kroz prizmu geografije. Vekovima su iste reke, planinski venci, pustinje i okeani predstavljali geografske izazove za vojske. Drugi svetski rat nije bio izuzetak. Šume, ravnice, pustinje i mora pomagali su vojskama ili su im otežavali mnogo pre vremena vojskovođa Drugog svetskog rata. Uklanjamo političke granice kako bismo otkrili topografiju koja se krije iza njih i razotkrili fascinantne, a često i presudne, veze između geografije i ratova.

programme.title: Tenk - najjače oružje Drugog svetskog rata

programme.desc: Pratimo prvo aktivno iskopavanje faraonove grobnice, u kultnoj Dolini kraljeva, još od grobnice kralja Tuta, pre jednog veka, i otkrivamo nove tajne o poznatim egipatskim vladarima.

programme.title: Dolina kraljeva - otkrivanje tajne grobnice
programme.desc: Pratimo prvo aktivno iskopavanje faraonove grobnice, u kultnoj Dolini kraljeva, još od grobnice kralja Tuta, pre jednog veka, i otkrivamo nove tajne o poznatim egipatskim vladarima.

programme.title: Grobovi egipatskih sveštenica
programme.desc: Tim egipatskih arheologa otkrio je do skoro nepoznato groblje koje otvara prozor u jedinstveni period u istoriji drevnog Egipta. Artefakti pronađeni u grobnicama govore nam da one pripadaju privilegovanim ženama koje su živele tokom zaboravljenog perioda drevne egipatske istorije, vremena kada su kušitski kraljevi iz Nubije kontrolisali Egipat kroz moć datu ženama regentkinjama _ božijim ženama Amuna. Pratimo iskopavanje grobnica u realnom vremenu i svedočimo otkriću divnih artefakata koji su pripadali ženama koje su živele tokom 8. veka pre nove ere.

programme.title: Abu Simbel: giganti sa Nila
programme.desc: Pre više od 3 000 godina, Ramzes II započeo je građenje dva kolosalna hrama, posvećena faraonu i njegovoj ženi Nefertari. Radnici su iskopali 55 metara u dubnu brda koje ima pogled na Nil i napravili gigantske odaje, sa stubovima od preko 10 metara. Statue faraona koji sedi na tronu visoke su po 20 metara, a fasade ova dva hrama oslikavale su sve norme tog perioda. Kako je ovakav poduhvat uopšte bio moguć i kako su Egipćani uspeli da organizuju i vode ovakav projekat, koji je od delte Nila udaljen 1 500 kilometara?Arhitekte, arheolozi i inženjeri pronašli su odgovore na ova pitanja u jednom drugom kolosalnom izazovu _ rasklapanju ove strukture kako bi je zaštitili od nadolazećih voda reke Nil.

programme.title: Traganje za blagom sa Betani Hjuz
programme.desc: Betani istražuje jadransku obalu Albanije. U potrazi za dvorcima u Albaniji, ona obilazi i drevna rimska vrata u Orikumu i Apoloniji, zatim Ohridsko jezero, kao i otomanski grad Berat.

programme.title: Faraoni u ratu
programme.desc: Helenistički faraoni su se vekovima borili protiv Seleukida. Ptolomej IV se suočio sa Antiohom Velikim kod Rafije sa 100.000 ljudi i ratnim slonovima. Otkrijte borce, pomorsku strategiju i posledice.

programme.title: Hitlerov DNK - genetski kod diktatora

programme.desc: Pridružite se arheolozima koji dešifruju dnevnik novootkrivenog radnika na piramidi, star 4500 godina. Mogu li rekonstruisati drevni čamac i otkriti tajne o tome kako je Velika piramida izgrađena?

programme.title: Šove - prvo veliko remek delo čovečanstva
programme.desc: Godine 1994, tajna pećina Šove otkrivena je u Francuskoj, zapečaćena više od 20 000 godina i savršeno očuvana. Unutra se nalazilo preko 1 000 zadivljujućih praistorijskih umetničkih dela. Ovaj dokumentarac prati naučnike u njihovoj tridesetogodišnjoj potrazi za odgovorom na pitanje ko ju je stvorio, kako je preživela milenijume i kako zaštititi ovo arheološko, geološko i umetničko čudo za buduća pokolenja.

programme.title: Iznik, potonula enigma
programme.desc: Turska, 2014. godine. Tokom rutinskog leta iznad jezera Iznik otkriveni su potonuli ostaci vizantijske bazilike iz 4. veka. Ovo neverovatno otkriće inspirisalo je naučnike da istraže istorijsku i geološku pozadinu koja se krije iza potonuća ove crkve, koja je sagrađena u drevnom rimskom gradu Nikeji, koji je sada poznat pod imenom Izni. Kako je crkvu progutalo jedno od najvećih jezera u Turskoj? Na koji način i zbog čega je ona uništena? Šta se desilo sa njenom zajednicom? Tokom istrage, javlja se još jedna sumnja. Da li je moguće da se u baziliki održap prvi Nikejski sabor?

programme.title: Drugi svetski rat: Cena vlasti
programme.desc: Priča o tome kako se svet, koji se stvarao vekovima, potpuno promenio u nekoliko ratnih godina. Tradicionalne moći izgubile su svoj značaj, u naletu novih snaga koje su oblikovale svet.

programme.title: Ratne fabrike
programme.desc: Nevažno koliko vojnika imate, koliko su vam pametni generali ili kakva vam je strategija, nećete pobediti u ratu ako nemate dovoljno metaka, aviona i hrane. II sv. rat je bio rat vođen između fabrika.

programme.title: Traganje za blagom sa Betani Hjuz

programme.title: Faraoni u ratu

programme.title: Nacisti - niti zla
programme.desc: Već u posleratnim pivnicama Minhena, Adolf Hitler je počeo da osvaja naciju očajnički željnu nade. Osnovao je pokret koji je okupio lojalni uži krug vođen ambicijom, ekstremizmom i slepom odanošću. Ova zanimljiva serija otkriva kako su ekonomska previranja, povređeni nacionalni ponos i Hitlerovo "harizmatično" vođstvo doveli do neviđene brutalnosti koju su oblikovali muškarci i žene koji su mu bili najbliži. Svaka epizoda fokusira se na jednu nacističku figuru i pruža uvid u njihove živote. To su niti koje su činile Hitlerovu noćnu moru.

programme.title: Hitlerove igre u boji - Berlin 1936.
programme.desc: Tokom dve nedelje u avgustu 1936. godine, u Berlinu, kamere su zabeležile najveći svetski sportski spektakl, uključujući i trijumfe rekordnog sprintera Džesija Ovensa, koji je osvojio zlatnu medalju. Berlinske Olimpijske igre bile su prekretnica _ mnoge inovacije uvedene 1936. godine, poput televizijskog prenosa i štafete sa bakljom, postale su deo svakih narednih Igara. Ovaj dokumentarac priča o izvanrednim amaterima koji su se istakli, ali i o tome kako je Hitler koristio Igre kao propagandu za svoj brutalni režim. Koristeći crno-belu arhivu, transformisanu najsavremenijom restauracijom i kolorizacijom, ovo je priča o 16 dana koji su osvojili svet _ i zaveli ga.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: In this episode we visit the Kennedy Space Center located on Florida's famous "Space Coast." We'll speak to NASA engineers about the past, present and future of American space travel, as well as take a look at the attractions KSC has to offer.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Heatwaves have caused cities to literally meltdown and systems to fail, how are we working with nature's heat? When two Cyclones collide, we get the Fujiwhara Effect, how is this possible and how does it manifest? Floods occur around the world and the world is learning how to cope, combat and prevent damage and share lessons. How do you classify a Blizzard, and let's look at some of the worst blizzards that have occurred on earth. Do you really know how to measure Rainfall and how to identify violent rain from a shower or appreciate when we have had enough or too much?

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: A snapshot of Seasons, how they work together and keep the globe in balance. Droughts are explored in terms of how we can predict them, proof our lives from them and collect data because of them. Hurricanes are explained, their power revealed and the measures that are used to help us survive their impact. Thunderstorms have a few stages of development that roll out in a particular order.

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Trolling coho at Calvert Island and on a big Chinook Salmon quest Southbound around Cape Caution and Port Hardy!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray Mears explores the Great Barrier Reef starting on the Queensland mainland taking a boat out to Hervey Bay with whale expert Wally Franklin. They witness a mother hump back whale teaching her three month old calf the whale moves needed to survive the long migration to Antarctica.He flies out to Lady Elliot Island at the southernmost tip of the Great Barrier Reef where he goes scuba diving on the coral reef and discovers giant turtles and manta rays and shoals of big eyed trevelly fish.Back on the island Ray helps marine biologist Maggie O'Neal plant a Pisonia tree and finds out how the Pisonia trees kill the Black Noddy bird's that nest in them in order to use their corpses as a fertile compost given the unforgiving ground of a coral island.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Join us as we discover the amazing history of this ancient city through its religion, royal lineage, architecture and art. In the markets, Bill shows you how to buy souvenirs like a pro. We visit the Golconda Fort where the ultimate in diamond souvenirs originated. And, of course, no visit to Hyderabad would be complete without taking a look at its high-tech and movie industries, which have revolutionized the city.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: No city in the Great Thar Desert of West India has had the sway that Jodhpur has. Giant forts, impressive palaces and a legendary royal hero that frees his people from tyrannical outsiders all make this a fascinating historic romp.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: The Great Rift Valley is actually where the continent of Africa is literally tearing itself apart. It's a geologic phenomenon where one side is a rainforest full of colorful birds and strange monkeys and the other, a large lake centered on a vast plain. Two bordering eco-zones…double the wildlife.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: If it's rhinos you want to see, you must visit Hluhluwe-Imfolozi Wildlife Park. This huge wilderness area has the highest density of rhino in the world. In addition to the rhino, we locate a pride of lions that is truly amazing. Mkuze National Park is a treasure trove of rare antelope and various other big game. Best of all, there is often no other guests, so this is one of Africa's best hidden gems.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: Athletes from across the world are competing in skier cross and big mountain freeskiing for pride glory and big bucks.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: Behind the scenes of a mountain bike action movie with the top riders in the world hitting new stunts and tricks that will elevate the sport of freeride mountain biking.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Of Boats And Men
programme.desc: Travelling by boat bears a priceless sense of Freedom and offers endless new vistas to all passengers. Across waterways around the world Boats are an essential tool of daily life whether they carry goods, serve as utilities or services in remote areas.

programme.title: The Blue Realm
programme.desc: The tiny island nation of Tonga in the remote South Pacific is a haven for the magnificent mammals. With few natural resources or other means of income, the country is considering opening it's waters to foreign whaling fleets in exchange for hard currency. The merits and legitimacy of scientific whaling by Japan and other nations is hotly debated. The iconic species is a favorite of whale watchers from Alaska to Mexico and the stage is set for an epic battle between whalers and conservationists. Humpbacks: From Tonga to Antarctica also features Paul Watson of the Sea Shepherd Society.

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: Jonathan joins an expedition to recruit a new Blue World camera operator in the form of a 1,000 pound Tiger shark! Working with experienced shark handlers, he puts a camera on the dorsal fin of the shark to see what it can film all by itself. But will Jonathan get his camera back? Next, he joins an experienced cave diver to explore a famous underwater cave in Northern Florida (USA).

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: Cave diving is the most difficult and dangerous type of diving, so the training to become a certified cave diver is arduous. This episode documents Jonathan's actual cave training in the Bahamas and follows him as he learns how to dive safely in the overhead environment of a cave in an attempt to earn his full cave diver certification.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Posse the red panda and Santiago the saki have been having issues with their teeth. The dentist has arrived but he's got some good news and bad news. The good news is neither of them have to foot the bill. The bad news is, he's brought his big pliers! Ever heard the tale of how the blue throated macaw parrot was saved from extinction and started a new fashion trend in the process? Loro Parque reports from the Bolivian front line and the front row of the local fashion parade!

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: For over a year, the staff at Loro Parque have been patiently waiting for a huge event to take place. Morgan, the deaf orca is about to give birth to her very first calf. The stakes are high, and the staff are holding their collective breath as the scene is set for the greatest natural phenomenon in the zoo's history.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: Fanged Spiders with their scurrying bites. The Scorpion with its deadly sting... A sinister cold bloodied crocodile. The hypnotizing venomous snake. Or the King of Beasts, the Lion? Which one is the most dangerous? Lion _ With golden fur and regal mane, the lion reigns as the 'King of Beasts'. Scorpions _ In scorched deserts, danger awakens after sunset. Spiders _ Masters of webs and venom, spiders haunt myth and imagination. Snakes _ Feared and revered, snakes symbolize power, death, and rebirth. Crocodile _ Ancient and deadly, crocodiles inspire fear and legend across the globe.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The charming kangaroo. The cuddly koala. The beautiful Butterfly. The cheerful clown fish. Or the endearing budgerigar _ which is the cutest of them all? Clownfish _ Tropical oceans shimmer with dazzling marine life like the vibrant clownfish. Kangaroo _ Australia's countryside pulses with thousands of bounding kangaroos. Monarch Butterfly _ Monarchs fill the skies, delicate and stunning in flight. Budgerigar _ Social and lively, wild budgies flock in hundreds across Australia. Koala _ Soft-furred and beloved, koalas are one of Australia's most iconic animals.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: In nature, both males and females fight fiercely—especially females defending their young. Most battles occur within the same species over food, territory, status, or mates. While not always fatal, these fights can lead to death. Animals protect food sources directly or by defending territory rich in prey. This territorial aggression helps distribute populations but can also limit them—like wolves starving without territory. Though fighting can secure survival, it comes at a cost: injury, exhaustion, and death. Often, avoiding conflict is the wisest strategy.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Prey must constantly avoid predators, and any defensive adaptation boosts survival. Speed is a key defense—antelope are built to run, chased by sprinters like cheetahs. Over time, predators evolved to be fast, and prey evolved to be faster. Antelope also travel long distances for food. Ostriches, though flightless, are the fastest-running birds. The Golden Wheel spider escapes danger by turning into a rolling wheel. In the Race of Life, survival depends on clever, sometimes surprising adaptations.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Killer armies collaborate to take down larger prey. On land, a zebra's kick can kill, but in the water it's easy meat for a congregation of crocodiles. Wild dogs may not seem like fearsome predators, but a pack kills fast, brutally and often.

programme.title: Creative Killers
programme.desc: Savuti is big cat country, where only the most resourceful predators thrive. This film follows three characters through winter as small game vanishes and buffalo arrive. The Marsh Pride faces tough terrain and rival lions, while Saba, the matriarch, struggles after a hyena attack. A lone female leopard adapts her hunting strategy to survive in a lion-dominated landscape. Through nighttime hunts and clever use of terrain, these predators battle Savuti's harsh conditions and each other.

programme.title: Speed Kills
programme.desc: In the forest's dark underworld, there's a lot more happening than meets the eye. Under every rock, behind every tree, death could be lurking.Africa's largest cobra is beat to the chase by the Giant bullfrog. Big Brown Bats use sonar to take out Wax moths at high speed. And the world's 2nd fastest cat leaps 10 feet into the air after its aerial prey.When death comes to the underworld, it takes the express!

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: Another rare species and close relative of manatees is the dugong. Dugongs cling to survival in a few isolated corners of the globe. In marine sanctuaries in Abu Dhabi, the bizarre animals have been notoriously difficult to find, let alone photograph. Manatees and Dugongs features exclusive HD imagery of the mammals in the wild and examines efforts of scientists to protect the two species. The program also includes thrilling captures and field exams of manatees in Florida.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: As Loro Parque's head vet, Jorge never knows from one day to the next what will come through his clinic. From tending to oversexed otters, fine-footed flamingoes or armoured armadillos, a day spent with Jorge, is a day immersed in nature from the four corners of the globe. Ever seen a grown man hug a turtle? For Javier, Loro Parque's Head of Environmental Affairs, it's all part of the job! He's hitting the high seas of Tenerife with a turtle tracker in hand to help with scientific research _ but first he's just got to locate the turtle _ 2,000 meters down in the ocean!

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: In this episode we explore Las Vegas' lesser known past. We visit the National Atomic Testing museum to learn about how the desert outside of Vegas was used for testing America's secret nuclear weapons. We also visit the Mormon Fort, the first permanent non-native settlement in the area, as well as the Neon Museum.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: It's island living in the Keys on this episode of TTH. We learn about the islands treasure hunting history at the Mel Fisher Museum. Then we'll explore Fort Jefferson, an isolated fort in the Gulf of Mexico that defended the islands. American literature enthusiasts will enjoy a look at Ernest Hemingway's Key West home, where some of his most famous works were penned.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: How are Rainbows formed and what's their science? We look at the largest Hail ever recorded and explain why it comes in so many shapes and sizes. Global Warming is a big issue and topic, and we give a nutshell insight to its meaning and impact on many levels. Forecasting is key and crucial to living with nature and its weather, as it involves precision technologies and expertise. Typhoon Halyan is an example of one of the most devastating storms in recent history and its story illustrates the power and destruction that Typhoons can cause.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Snow is a fascinating world of crystals that animals, plants, and humans have had to adapt to, in order to benefit from its best and survive its worst attributes. Some communities live with Tornadoes by building homes with survival features and rather than get out of their paths, they rely on warning systems and classifications. And behind all great weather events is Wind, find out how and why it can change from a gentle breeze into a devastating gale force and where does it go? Nature's force can be mystical and puzzling and the Sunshower has been the subject of myths and legends and superstitions, but it does have a scientific explanation.

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Trolling monster Chinook Salmon with Big Jim Henschke outside Port Hardy, BC!

programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Ranthambore National Park is part of Project Tiger, a unique wildlife conservation program set up to insure the preservation of the magnificent Tiger. In Ranthambore we encounter the tiger along with Sambar and Blue Bull, Wild Boar and Langur Monkey. We also explore the historic side of Ranthambore which is dotted with ruins of the fort that protected the region for hundreds of years. We end the episode with a tour of a very different national park. Board a rickshaw and join your guide as he explores Keoladeo National Park, known for its abundant bird life.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: India can match Africa mega-animal for mega-animal. The three biggest—elephant, buffalo and rhino are found in large numbers in only one national park in India—Kazaringa. Join Bill as he attempts to check each of these highly endangered and dangerous herbivores off his bucket list.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: To this day sisal, a rope making fiber plant, is a mainstay of the economy. Journeys tours the capital city of Tanzania and its diverse religious institutions before heading into sisal country. We'll learn about the German influences and the seldom heard story of Livingstone's final trip across Africa.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: From the streets of Soweto to the colonial Union Building, the metro area of Joburg is a mix of architecture, people and traditions. Johannesburg is more than just a big city—it's also home to one of the world's best safari parks.

programme.title: Nomads

programme.title: Nomads

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: The International Space Station is undoubtedly the jewel in the crown of low Earth orbit; observation post, research lab and class room. Equally however there are many other assets orbiting Earth that are even more important to our everyday lives; delivering communications, weather observation, global positioning and resource management the list is growing with every year.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: Our seafaring nature has translated well to the space age, seeking to sail out into the unknown in search of riches of one kind or another. While Europe and Asia continue their interest in the resource rich Moon, The United States and NASA have set their sights on nothing less than manned missions to Mars. Can they manage to go shore to shore on the most dangerous of unknown seas, deep space.

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: Learn how almond nuts get transformed into "milk." And why are movie trailers shown at the beginning of the film? We'll keep your attention so you'll want to stick around for the answer. And learn how detergents make your clothes seem brighter and whiter.

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: Learn how a pharmacist and an accountant created the most famous drink in the world, coca cola! And, learn the "Bear" truth behind how a U.S. president helped create everyone's favorite stuffed toy, The Teddy Bear! Then, how did a piece of wire accidentally "Slink" its way to become a fantastic fun toy for children? Plus, how a the wiffle ball was invented.

programme.title: Water: H2O Stories
programme.desc: Water: H2O Stories is a 3x52 series revisiting the story of water on planet Earth and its disrupted course over time which has led to the 21st century biggest challenge.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: The beauty, magic, and the science behind the Auroras at both ends of the earth, show them to be more than just a protective magnetic layer. The technology used to measure Wind Speed is finely calibrated with an interesting formula. The Tides remind us of our connection to the moon and our place in the solar system and are monitored for any significant change can have implications for industry, communities, and our ocean life. Earthquakes often make news headlines so how are they measured and predicted and what can we learn from them about our planet? Acid Rain is a manufactured weather event, the result of manmade industry mixing with nature to result in international treaties to lessen emissions and pollution.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Rubber was first used by South American tribes for waterproofing and bouncing balls. Westerners struggled with melting rubber until Charles Goodyear discovered vulcanization, making rubber durable. This sparked the rubber boom, enriching cities like Manaus. Britain broke Brazil's monopoly by smuggling seeds. Later, synthetic rubber and Kevlar were developed—Kevlar is so tough it can stop bullets. Rubber's journey is full of quirky discoveries.

programme.title: Desperate Hours
programme.desc: In this episode, we examine the devastating power of floods. Defined as water covering land not normally submerged, floods can unleash terror through raging currents and flash floods. Disasters like Brazilian landslides, Hurricane Katrina, and the 2004 tsunami killed hundreds of thousands and displaced millions. Urbanization worsens flooding by reducing soil absorption. Better building codes and coordinated relief could reduce destruction, but floods remain a deadly force of nature.

programme.desc: The legendary wild dingo, the iconic kangaroos, vicious feral cats, the delightfully bizarre platypus and the unmistakably cuddly koala _ all call Australia home. Koala _ Hidden high in gum trees, the koala is one of Australia's most beloved animals. Dingo _ Sleek, agile, and descended from wolves, dingoes are Australia's top land carnivores. Kangaroo _ With powerful legs and iconic bounds, kangaroos embody the spirit of Australia. Wild Cats _ Over 12 million wild house cats roam Australia's diverse landscapes. Platypus _ Unique and mysterious, the platypus is one of Australia's most enchanting creatures.

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: The tiny island nation of Tonga in the remote South Pacific is a haven for the magnificent mammals. With few natural resources or other means of income, the country is considering opening it's waters to foreign whaling fleets in exchange for hard currency. The merits and legitimacy of scientific whaling by Japan and other nations is hotly debated. The iconic species is a favorite of whale watchers from Alaska to Mexico and the stage is set for an epic battle between whalers and conservationists. Humpbacks: From Tonga to Antarctica also features Paul Watson of the Sea Shepherd Society.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: The ocean is a harsh world where survival depends on feeding and avoiding predators. Sea creatures use camouflage, bright colors, venom, and group behavior for protection. Some hide, others rely on safety in numbers. Even venomous animals must stay alert. From top predators to bottom feeders, each species has evolved unique strategies. Defense includes toxins, teeth, mimicry, and camouflage. Nudibranchs, clownfish, squid, octopus, and orcas are just a few winners in the underwater Race of Life, adapting brilliantly to their environment.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Insects may be small, but their survival strategies are fierce. They thrive in diverse environments thanks to their exoskeletons, which protect against impact, chemicals, and water. Wings help them escape danger or seek food and mates. Dragonflies hover and dart after prey, monarchs undergo stunning metamorphosis, and praying mantises blend into greenery before striking. Social insects like ants and bees live in colonies. From camouflage to flight, every adaptation helps insects stay in the Race of Life.

programme.title: On the Cities' Rooftops
programme.desc: How is life on the city's roofs? This series scales new heights, exploring apartment buildings, towers and monuments to discover a world full of unsuspected treasures : our rooftops. By day and night, the population changes on these heights. There are people who work here, people who live here, and others who come here to relax. The world's rooftops are a continual hive of activity.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: Deep in the heart of Mexico's Yucatan, Jonathan is exploring remote cenotes in the jungle that were once used for Mayan rituals. Just reaching the surface of the water requires rappelling down from the forest above. But then, beneath the surface, he encounters strange alien life forms that live in total darkness, and the remains of humans and animal sacrifices from an ancient culture.

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: In the Flower Garden Banks National Marine Sanctuary, Jonathan investigates some of the densest coral reefs in the Caribbean as they spawn under cover of darkness. Then he heads over to Silver Springs for the Sea Hunt Forever Festival, celebrating the classic TV show Sea Hunt and the vintage scuba gear that was used on the program.

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: The Internet began in 1969 as a Cold War military tool for secure communication. Email followed in 1972. Decades later, Tim Berners-Lee introduced the World Wide Web, linking documents and revolutionizing public access. His idea, once called "vague but exciting," reshaped how we share, protest, and connect. Now, with Web 3.0 on the horizon, the Internet may evolve to understand human needs—what's next in this digital journey?

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Early computers include the Antikythera device and Babbage's engines, though his designs were ahead of their time. WWII accelerated the need for powerful calculators. Early machines were massive but weak. The invention of the transistor in the 1950s replaced bulky vacuum tubes, enabling personal computers. Today, supercomputers help design planes, buildings—even target genes. Computers are evolving fast—what's next?

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: If you have ever gone to a hockey game, or gone ice-skating, there is one revolutionary machine that helps keep the fun and action going! And that's all thanks to the Zamboni® Ice Resurfacing Machine. You'll learn how and why it was invented! And ever notice some pistachio nuts are red in color? We'll throw up the red flag and explain why the color is simply a cover up!

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: If you ever go camping there is one thing you do not want to leave home without, the swiss army knife! We'll explain how it evolved into the most famous knife in the world and how the company's name got "Cut" together! And where did the term "cup of Joe" come from as well as the word java? And we all love a juicy hamburger, so where did these chopped meat patties come from?

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: The Japanese Asteroid sample return mission has reached its target and is surveying the space rock ready to dip down and take a sample. The return of asteroid material to Earth will aid scientists in the evolving asteroid planetary defense systems.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: Two new space telescopes are in orbit and completing their shakedown; Gaia and TESS they too will be joined by the James Webb Telescope. Together they will be opening up a whole new vista into time and space.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: It's the biggest museum in the world…the museum of artworks stolen over the centuries and never rediscovered. These works haunt the nightmares of their owners, and occupy the days of hundreds of police officers across the world, as well as those of a handful of private agencies; no country or museum of importance can claim to have been spared. According to Interpol, art theft is the fourth largest criminal trade, after the drug trade, the weapons trade and money laundering. How could it be otherwise, when the soaring price of art propels the value of some paintings into the tens of millions of Euros? This world appears to be full of mysteries. Crime syndicates rub shoulders with petty criminals and the police care more about recovering the items than they do about arresting the perpetrators.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: The Body Transfer Illusion tricks the brain into feeling ownership of a fake body part, like in the rubber hand experiment. The Autokinetic Effect makes stationary lights seem to move in darkness. The Moon Illusion causes the moon to appear larger near the horizon due to visual references. Geometric illusions distort shapes and lines through clever design. Stereoscopy lets us perceive depth by merging two flat images into one 3D view.

programme.title: Wonder
programme.desc: Animation creates motion from still images shown in rapid sequence. Aviation illusions affect pilots' balance due to conflicting sensory input. The spinning dancer illusion shows bistable perception—viewers may see it spin in either direction. Mirages occur when light bends through layers of air at different temperatures. Rainbows form when sunlight refracts and reflects through water droplets, splitting light into visible colors.

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.desc: U dokumentarnoj seriji "Inventar faune" Frederik Presl nalazi način da istakne lepotu svake životinje, a takođe nam donosi i pregršt informacija u brojkama, koje do sada nismo imali prilike da čujemo. Da li ste znali da pelikani mogu da lete 24 sata bez prestanka, da ajkula čekićara ima 10 puta izraženije čulo mirisa od ostalih vrsta ajkula, da potkovičaste krabe imaju krv plave boje ili da bradavičasta svinja može da izdrži dva meseca bez vode?

programme.desc: Portret Radivoja Koraća, legendarnog Žućka, čije je ime ostalo duboko upisano u istoriju jugoslovenske košarke. Izuzetna košgeterska sposobnost učinila ga je jednim od najdominantnijih igrača svog vremena. Dokumentarac Zdravka Randića podseća na njegovu igru, sportske domete i prerano prekinut život, čuvajući uspomenu na košarkaša koji je postao sinonim za vrhunsku efikasnost.

programme.title: Radivoje Korać
programme.desc: Portret Radivoja Koraća, legendarnog Žućka, čije je ime ostalo duboko upisano u istoriju jugoslovenske košarke. Izuzetna košgeterska sposobnost učinila ga je jednim od najdominantnijih igrača svog vremena. programme.title: Mađioničar: Zadivljujući život i rad Orsona Velsa
programme.desc: Dokumentarni film koji istražuje život i karijeru legendarnog reditelja i glumca Orsona Velsa. Kroz retke arhivske snimke, intervjue i priče ljudi koji su sarađivali sa Velsom, film pruža uvid u genijalnost i kontroverze koje su okruživale ovog umetnika. Gledaoci će biti fascinirani pričom o čoveku koji je bio jednako vešt u pozorištu, filmu i magiji.

programme.title: Velike ličnosti
programme.desc: Kroz ovaj serijal upoznajte najznačajnije ličnosti koje su obeležile našu cvilizaciju.

programme.title: Ljubav, nemačke marke i smrt
programme.desc: Sporazum Savezne Republike Nemačke s Turskom iz 1961. godine ne samo da je doveo "gastarbajtere" u Nemačku već i njihovu muziku. Društveni fenomen koji je vrlo poznat narodima s prostora bivše Jugoslavije. Dokumentarni filmski esej Cema Kaye tutorijal je iz tursko-nemačke novije istorije koji donosi priču o poslovima turskih emigranata na montažnoj traci, nostalgiji i spajanju porodice, bazaru na železničkoj stanici u Berlinu, ksenofobiji i rasizmu, setnim pesmama ranih godina i hip-hop periodu nakon ujedinjenja Nemačke. Ovo je svet radija "Yilmaz", raznih muzičkih pravaca, svadbenih bendova koji pevaju, takođe, i na kurdskom i arapskom jeziku kako bi zadovoljili zahteve tržišta. Opsežna arhivska istraživanja i interesovanje za tursku popularnu kulturu teme su koje se ponavljaju u radu Cema Kaye. Filmom "Ljubav, nemačke marke i smrt" stvorio je ritmičnu i živo ispričanu filmsku enciklopediju turske muzike u Nemačkoj.

programme.title: Sava Šumanović
programme.desc: Život i stvaralaštvo Save Šumanovića predstavljeni su kroz pregled njegovog slikarskog razvoja, od ranih umetničkih uticaja i boravka u Parizu do perioda provedenog u Šidu. Kroz njegova najpoznatija dela, film se osvrće na karakterističan odnos prema boji, svetlosti i pejzažu, kao i na motive Srema koji zauzimaju značajno mesto u njegovom opusu. Tekst filma potpisuje Živorad Žika Mitrović, koji kroz pripovedanje prati razvoj Šumanovićevog likovnog izraza i njegovo mesto u srpskom modernom slikarstvu.

programme.desc: Dokumentarni serijal "Svetska baština" bavi se najpoznatijim svetskim slikarima, njihovim delima i pričama koje se kriju iza njih.

programme.title: Čudesna priroda
programme.desc: Dokumentarni serijal koji vam pruža priliku da krenete na uzbudljivo putovanje i upoznate brojna čuda prirode! Posetite različite krajeve sveta i upoznajte biljne i životinjske vrste za koje ranije niste znali da postoje.

programme.title: Čudesna priroda
programme.desc: Dokumentarni serijal koji vam pruža priliku da krenete na uzbudljivo putovanje i upoznate brojna čuda prirode! Posetite različite krajeve sveta i upoznajte biljne i životinjske vrste za koje ranije niste znali da postoje.

programme.title: Dan kad je umrla rok zvezda
programme.desc: Ova potpuno nova serija fokusiraće se na smrt i naknadno oplakivanje nekih od najvećih muzičkih legendi. Istražićemo dane koji vode do umetnikove smrti i jedinstveni uticaj koji ti događaji imaju na obožavatelje i medije. Svaka epizoda sadržaće najvažnije delove karijere koji ih vode do legendarnog statusa i obožavanja obožavalaca širom sveta.

programme.title: Mađioničar: Zadivljujući život i rad Orsona Velsa
programme.desc: Dokumentarni film koji istražuje život i karijeru legendarnog reditelja i glumca Orsona Velsa. Kroz retke arhivske snimke, intervjue i priče ljudi koji su sarađivali sa Velsom, film pruža uvid u genijalnost i kontroverze koje su okruživale ovog umetnika. Gledaoci će biti fascinirani pričom o čoveku koji je bio jednako vešt u pozorištu, filmu i magiji.

programme.title: Velike ličnosti
programme.desc: Kroz ovaj serijal upoznajte najznačajnije ličnosti koje su obeležile našu cvilizaciju.

programme.title: Ljubav, nemačke marke i smrt
programme.desc: Sporazum Savezne Republike Nemačke s Turskom iz 1961. godine ne samo da je doveo "gastarbajtere" u Nemačku već i njihovu muziku. Društveni fenomen koji je vrlo poznat narodima s prostora bivše Jugoslavije. Dokumentarni filmski esej Cema Kaye tutorijal je iz tursko-nemačke novije istorije koji donosi priču o poslovima turskih emigranata na montažnoj traci, nostalgiji i spajanju porodice, bazaru na železničkoj stanici u Berlinu, ksenofobiji i rasizmu, setnim pesmama ranih godina i hip-hop periodu nakon ujedinjenja Nemačke. Ovo je svet radija "Yilmaz", raznih muzičkih pravaca, svadbenih bendova koji pevaju, takođe, i na kurdskom i arapskom jeziku kako bi zadovoljili zahteve tržišta. Opsežna arhivska istraživanja i interesovanje za tursku popularnu kulturu teme su koje se ponavljaju u radu Cema Kaye. Filmom "Ljubav, nemačke marke i smrt" stvorio je ritmičnu i živo ispričanu filmsku enciklopediju turske muzike u Nemačkoj.

programme.title: Sava Šumanović
programme.desc: Život i stvaralaštvo Save Šumanovića predstavljeni su kroz pregled njegovog slikarskog razvoja, od ranih umetničkih uticaja i boravka u Parizu do perioda provedenog u Šidu. Kroz njegova najpoznatija dela, film se osvrće na karakterističan odnos prema boji, svetlosti i pejzažu, kao i na motive Srema koji zauzimaju značajno mesto u njegovom opusu. Tekst filma potpisuje Živorad Žika Mitrović, koji kroz pripovedanje prati razvoj Šumanovićevog likovnog izraza i njegovo mesto u srpskom modernom slikarstvu.

programme.title: Nobelova nagrada
programme.desc: Nobelova nagrada je internacionalna nagrada, koju godišnje dodeljuju švedske i norveške institucije, kao znak priznanja za akademska, kulturna, i/ili naučna dostignuća.

programme.title: Doktor mozak
programme.desc: Poljak Miroslav Zabek je u svet neurohirurgije doneo pravu revoluciju! Ovaj dokumentarni serijal govori o pacijentima koji su zahvaljujući njegovom radu došli do izlečenja.

programme.title: Svetska baština
programme.desc: Dokumentarni serijal "Svetska baština" bavi se najpoznatijim svetskim slikarima, njihovim delima i pričama koje se kriju iza njih.

programme.title: Inventar faune
programme.desc: U dokumentarnoj seriji "Inventar faune" Frederik Presl nalazi način da istakne lepotu svake životinje, a takođe nam donosi i pregršt informacija u brojkama, koje do sada nismo imali prilike da čujemo. Da li ste znali da pelikani mogu da lete 24 sata bez prestanka, da ajkula čekićara ima 10 puta izraženije čulo mirisa od ostalih vrsta ajkula, da potkovičaste krabe imaju krv plave boje ili da bradavičasta svinja može da izdrži dva meseca bez vode?

programme.title: Serijski testeri
programme.desc: U garaži koja je za potrebe ovog projekta pretvorena u laboratoriju, grupa entuzijasta sprovodi različite eksperimente pokušavajući da potvrdi brojne naučne teorije. Svaki korak u eksperimentu je pažljivo isplaniran, a trio željan nauke na kraju svake teme daje detaljna objašnjenja.

programme.title: Verski spomenici
programme.desc: Dokumentarni serijal "Verski spomenici" donosi pogled na umetnička i arhitektonska dostignuća koja su utkana u hramove i crkve širom sveta.

programme.title: Čudesna priroda
programme.desc: Dokumentarni serijal koji vam pruža priliku da krenete na uzbudljivo putovanje i upoznate brojna čuda prirode! Posetite različite krajeve sveta i upoznajte biljne i životinjske vrste za koje ranije niste znali da postoje.

programme.desc: Dokumentarni serijal koji vam pruža priliku da krenete na uzbudljivo putovanje i upoznate brojna čuda prirode! Posetite različite krajeve sveta i upoznajte biljne i životinjske vrste za koje ranije niste znali da postoje.

Svaka epizoda sadržaće najvažnije delove karijere koji ih vode do legendarnog statusa i obožavanja obožavalaca širom sveta.

programme.title: Slatke prljave stvari
programme.desc: Oboje jedva sklapaju kraj sa krajem, a žive i u konstantom strahu od deportacije. Jedne noći, Okve dobija poziv od gošće hotela, inače prostitutke Džulijet, da popravi WC šolju u njenoj sobi, ali tamo otkriva ni manje ni više nego ljudsko srce. Tako saznaje da se, osim prostitucije i prodaje droge, u hotelu odvijala i mnogo veća i monstruoznija kriminalna aktivnost kao što je trgovina organima. Ipak, brzo biva ucenjen da o onome što je video nikom ne sme da priča, a s obzirom na svoju situaciju, plaši se i da obavesti policiju. U isto vreme, njemu i Senaj otvara se šansa za odlazak u Ameriku. Ostaje, međutim, pitanje da li može da zaboravi ono šta je video?

programme.title: Šapat iz kamena
programme.desc: Sredina je 20. veka. Odvažna mlada medicinska sestra spremna je da zakorači iza zidina usamljenog toskanskog zamka i pomogne mladiću koga je strah oterao u svet tišine. Verenin cilj je da utihnulog dečaka Džejkoba vrati u stvarnost. Koliko god se trudila, sa svakim novim korakom sve dublje zalazi u tamu koja počiva iza kamenih zidova. Ipak, Verenina glavna obeležja su njena izuzetna senzitivnost i dar da dospe do svakog deteta. U početku Džejkob je delovao uznemireno njenim prisustvom, dok je ona pomno pratila svaki njegov pokret. Tada je shvatila da se u unutrašnjem svetu mladog dečaka događa više nego što bi iko mogao da pomisli. Da li je pao pod surove čini duha nesrećno zazidanog u zidove zamka? Ne bi li spasila poslodavce, ali i sebe, Verena brzo mora da se suprotstavi aveti u čijoj će se nemilosti uskoro i sama naći.

programme.title: Do kraja
programme.desc: Soni se vraća iz vojske i u vozu upozna Ganera koji se takođe vraća iz vojske. U Indijanapolisu, njihovom rodnom gradu, nastave se družiti i provoditi. Povučenom Soniju, Ganer postaje uzor. Noći provode po barovima menjajući devojke. Uskoro Ganer upozna Marti, devojku koja se bavi umetnošću i kojoj je za razliku od ostalih želja, da ode živeti u Njujork, a ne da se uda i što pre ima decu. Sonijevi roditelji su zabrinuti zbog njegovih izlazaka i provoda. Ganerova majka Nina protiv je Marti, jer je Jevrejka. Ganer i Marti, jedne večeri upoznaju Sonija s Martinom prijateljicom Gejl. Soni se jako napije, šaljiv je i zanimljiv, ali kada ode u krevet s lepom Gejl, doživi neuspeh. Pijan i razočaran, Soni odlazi kući i seče vene.

programme.title: Karington
programme.desc: Karington je istinita priča o neobičnoj ljubavi između dvoje nekonformista u viktorijanskoj Engleskoj: ljubavi između slikarke Dore Karington (Ema Tompson) i pisca Litona Starkija (Džonatan Prajs). Dora je mlada engleska slikarka, članica grupe Blumsberi, grupe britanskih pisaca, slikara i ekscentrika u koju spadaju Virdžinija Vulf, E.M. Forster i njima slični, i gde se ona upoznaje sa Starkijem. Potvrđeni homoseksualac pre nego što se sreo sa Karingtonovom, Starki počinje da se raspituje ko je "prelepi dečak", da bi otkrio da je to žena. Šokiran ovim otkrićem,on otkriva da ga ona privlači i njih dvoje započinju neobićnu sedamnaestogodišnju ljubavnu aferu i prijateljstvo. Starki (najčuveniji po značajnom delu "Eminentni viktorijanci" i Dora konačno počinju da žive zajedno i doživljavaju niz neobičnih seksualnih iskustava sa ostalim članovima grupe, a ponekad i sa istim muškarcem; u jednom trenutku, Dora se čak udaje za drugog muškarca. Pa ipak, njihova veza opstaje, sve do Starkijeve smrti mogo godina kasnije.

programme.title: Kako da zadovoljite ženu
programme.desc: Kada njen posao čišćenja kuća muškarcima, izmakne kontroli, zrela žena mora da prihvati sopstvenu seksualnost, ako želi da napravi novi život za sebe.
